title: Fashion Point — App shell + landing experience (frontend)

requirements.summary: Implement a responsive public landing page with Fashion Point branding, hero, value props, and CTA (English copy).
acceptanceCriteria: Visiting the app shows a complete landing page (not a blank/template screen) with a hero section that includes the text “Fashion Point”.
Landing page is responsive (mobile + desktop layouts).
All visible UI text is in English.

file_operations.description: Create the Fashion Point public landing page with hero, value propositions, and a simple CTA section using responsive Tailwind layout. Use shadcn-ui composition (e.g., Card/Button) where appropriate. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Create the app root component that renders the landing experience as the default view (no blank/template screen). Ensure the landing page is reachable from initial load.

requirements.summary: Add a top header navigation with Home and Sign In; wire Sign In to Internet Identity using existing immutable template hooks.
acceptanceCriteria: Header is present on the landing page with “Home” and “Sign In”.
Clicking “Sign In” triggers Internet Identity login using existing template integration.
No changes are made to any immutable paths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.

file_operations.description: Create a reusable header with links/actions for Home and Sign In. Use the existing useInternetIdentity hook to trigger login on Sign In click; do not modify immutable hook files. Use shadcn-ui Button (composition) for actions. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Wire the AppHeader into the app layout so it appears on the landing page and Home navigates to the landing view (e.g., via link to root / or scroll-to-top behavior).

requirements.summary: Display authenticated UI state after login, including principal and Sign Out action.
acceptanceCriteria: When signed in, the UI displays an authenticated state including the user’s principal.
A “Sign Out” action is available and returns the UI to the signed-out state.

file_operations.description: Create an AuthStatus UI component that reads identity from useInternetIdentity, displays “Signed in” plus the principal string, and exposes a Sign Out action that calls clear(). Use shadcn-ui components (e.g., Badge/Button) via composition. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Integrate AuthStatus into the header: when signed out show Sign In; when signed in show principal + Sign Out. Keep all user-facing copy in English.

requirements.summary: Define and apply a cohesive Fashion Point theme (typography, spacing, colors) across header and landing; avoid blue/purple primary palette.
acceptanceCriteria: A consistent theme is visibly applied across the landing page and header (typography + color + spacing).
Primary palette is not dominated by blue/purple.

file_operations.description: Add Tailwind base styles and define a coherent theme using CSS variables consumed by shadcn-ui/Tailwind (background/foreground/primary/etc.). Choose a warm modern palette (e.g., sand/cream + charcoal + terracotta/amber accents) avoiding blue/purple as primary. Apply consistent typography and spacing defaults.

Apply the theme consistently to the landing page sections (typography scale, spacing rhythm, button styles) using Tailwind utilities aligned with the theme variables. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Apply the theme consistently to the header (background, border, typographic hierarchy, spacing) using Tailwind utilities aligned with the theme variables. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Add generated logo and hero images as static assets and render them on the landing page.
acceptanceCriteria: Generated images exist under frontend/public/assets/generated with the exact filenames specified in Image Requirements.
Landing page renders the logo and hero image from static assets (not fetched from backend).

file_operations.description: Add the generated static logo asset at the exact required path/filename: frontend/public/assets/generated/fashion-point-logo.dim_512x512.png.
Add the generated static hero image asset at the exact required path/filename: frontend/public/assets/generated/fashion-point-hero.dim_1600x900.png.

Render the static logo and hero image from frontend/public/assets/generated/fashion-point-logo.dim_512x512.png and frontend/public/assets/generated/fashion-point-hero.dim_1600x900.png within the landing page hero/branding sections (no backend fetching).
